name: translation-egress-q24-isolation
question: Does the multilingual-translation pipeline (FR-FBR-30) keep its privacy + Q24 invariants? Probe A proves from main.rs that the translation provider DEFAULTS to `off` (egress is opt-in; DEC-FBR-IMPL-26) and is never an unconditional cloud provider. Probe B proves NO human-facing surface reads `body_translated`: every fn referencing the column is in a tiny allowlist (the sole analyst consumer `list_member_bodies_for_cluster` + the worker writer `set_translation`) — a new public/end-user/board/admin-display read of the translation FAILS (Q24, DEC-FBR-IMPL-25; the verbatim original is what humans see). Probe C proves writer uniqueness: only `set_translation` writes (`SET body_translated`), no INSERT writes it, and it is CALLED only from the translate-after-accept worker (the async worker is the sole writer; never the request path). Probe D proves the latest `body_tsv` migration sources from `coalesce(body_translated, body)` (FTS indexes the translation with fallback). `--full` runs tests/translation_worker.rs (behavioral drift).

output.schema: PASS or FAIL <n> with probe-level offender detail. Exit 0 on PASS, 1 on FAIL, 2 on environment failure. Probe --full reports PENDING (not failure) until tests/translation_worker.rs lands.

consultation.typical_sessions_using: every-commit touching the translation pipeline, the feedback read surface, the provider construction, or the FTS source column

consumer_scope: feedbackmonk: the FR-FBR-30 implementer + every reviewer touching the translation provider/worker, any feedback read SQL, or the body_tsv FTS definition. A green oracle (A+B+C+D clean, --full clean-or-pending) is the FR-FBR-30 privacy/Q24 gate.
fallback: Probe A: read crates/feedbackmonk-api/src/main.rs `build_translation_provider` and confirm FEEDBACKMONK_TRANSLATION_PROVIDER defaults to "off" and the "off" arm returns Ok(None). Probe B: grep crate src for `body_translated`; confirm only set_translation + list_member_bodies_for_cluster reference it. Probe C: confirm only set_translation has `SET body_translated`, and only translation/worker.rs calls `.set_translation(`. Probe D: confirm the highest-numbered migration defining body_tsv uses coalesce(body_translated, body). Probe --full: cargo test -p feedbackmonk-api --test translation_worker.

provenance.authored_by: FR-FBR-30 Stream E (the verifiability surface for DEC-FBR-IMPL-26's privacy posture + the Q24 read-isolation invariant).
provenance.rationale: Testability Gate Flag 2 (Q2 privacy/Q24 read-isolation): a happy-path test confirms `translate -> consumer reads English`, but cannot prove the ABSENCE of a code path that routes body_translated to a public/end-user/board/admin-display surface, nor that a future edit can't flip the provider default to a cloud provider (silent egress) or revert the FTS source to the original (mis-stemming). Detection-from-code (provider construction + per-fn column referents + writer-call sites + migration FTS expr), the anti-reward-hacking leg — it cannot be satisfied by a self-reported is_private flag. Mirrors public-board-moderation-gate (board read isolation) and cors-allowlist-enforcement (provider/posture-from-code).
